jakarta-2010.notes: Source 4 is the list of the top 50 teams of the Indonesia National Contest (a different, online contest), so it is filed as a team list instead of rankings. Source 7 is a report, not an editorial; it names only the top three, the three best national teams and the best female team. Team counts differ between documents: scoreboard 67 rows, standings 236 rows (180 unranked with zero solved), report says 66 teams registered and 60 present. The site crawl holds 103 copies of one style sheet from a looping address and six copies of the front page as .aspx; I counted only 18 HTML pages and 2 PDFs.
